claims.statement: EU guidance says some products require involvement of a conformity-assessment organization and only duly notified bodies can issue legally recognized certificates in the scope for which they are notified.

contrary_evidence: The same guidance says some products can be self-assessed, so the paid capacity need is category-specific.
Manufacturers may choose among notified bodies, limiting durable scarcity.

economics.acquisition_route: Partnerships with importers, compliance consultants, distributors, and targeted manufacturer outreach
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A possible path is 25 monthly bookings at roughly 8000 PLN contribution plus recurring document-readiness subscriptions and defensible lab agreements
economics.founder_time: Initially 10-18 hours per week with technical review delegated to qualified consultants
economics.gross_margin_basis: Expected 35-60% on coordination and capacity premium after deposits, technical review, and failed-booking allowances
economics.payback: Unvalidated; ten to twenty completed bookings may recover deposits and setup
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 5000-15000 PLN coordination fee plus a transparent slot premium or 15-25% capacity margin
economics.retention_or_repeat: Manufacturers can return for new models; reserved capacity must be renewed with labs

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Scarce capacity agreements, completion history, category routing knowledge, and lab trust make the channel more useful over time
fingerprint.customer: Polish importers and small European or non-EU manufacturers of electrical and energy-related products
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Import consultants, distributors, hardware accelerators, marketplace sellers, and multilingual search-led outbound
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Reserved intake windows, eligibility triage, technical-document checklist, scheduling, and customer handoff to the qualified assessment body
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The manufacturer pays a reservation premium and coordination fee when a slot is booked, with the laboratory fee passed through transparently
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A product launch needs external conformity work and the manufacturer faces uncertain intake timing or an incomplete technical dossier

founder_fit: Can be built as a scheduling and data system rather than a laboratory
Quantitative capacity management suits the founder
Energy-equipment context overlaps the family business
Sales can be partner-led and does not require camera exposure
risks: Misrepresenting a voluntary certificate as legally valid would harm customers
Lab deposits may be lost when clients cancel
Advice errors could delay market entry or create product liability
Apparent scarcity may disappear or differ by product class

structure.control_point: Contractually reserved and customer-nominable testing or conformity-assessment windows
structure.critical_dependency: Qualified bodies must permit reserved-capacity nomination and customers must value faster access enough to pay a premium

thesis: Negotiate framework agreements that reserve monthly intake capacity at qualified testing laboratories and notified bodies, then package priority slots with document-readiness checks for energy-tech and electrical manufacturers entering the EU.
title: Reserved EU Conformity-Lab Slot Broker
uncertainties: No current lead-time bottleneck has been verified
Unknown whether labs allow slot reservation or customer substitution
Unknown demand and premium by product class
The business must avoid acting beyond its technical competence
